description: This file defines the PageInformation class, a Java POJO (Plain Old Java Object) used to encapsulate metadata about a web page such as title, description, keywords, and URL.

classes.name: PageInformation
classes.description: A serializable class representing web page metadata, including title, description, keywords, and URL.

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the page.

methods.name: setPageTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the page.

methods.name: getPageDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the page.

methods.name: setPageDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the page.

methods.name: getPageKeywords
methods.description: Returns the keywords associated with the page.

methods.name: setPageKeywords
methods.description: Sets the keywords for the page.

methods.name: getPageUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the page.

methods.name: setPageUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL of the page.
